comment: Obstacles of the arena (Obstacles.cs): lasting features of the ground, unlike terrain. solid: blocks everyone and every shot (a wall); fall: a Pokémon whose centre gets in (pushed, sliding, dashing) falls, unless its movementType is in passTypes (ROM: 2 float, 3 through walls, 4 lava, 5 swim), and comes back to the last safe tile, losing fallDamage of its max HP (+ fallStatus). Walking never takes anyone in: the controllers stop at the edge. speedMul / slideAccel: like terrains, for walkable obstacles. holdsTerrain: terrain may lie on it (electrified water). shotsPass: projectiles fly over it (true unless solid). tileset: ROM dungeon tileset whose secondary layer (water, lava or void, with PMD's own banks) draws it, extracted by Tools/setup.py into Assets/Resources/ObstacleTiles; otherwise the hand-made sheet obstacle_<key> of Resources/Effects (overlay: drawn over what it covers, like a bridge over the void); color: fallback look when neither exists. interactions: a move of type 'byType' (ROM type id) hitting the obstacle 'on', or terrain 'byTerrain' laid on it or on a tile next to it, turns it into 'becomes' ('' removes it), for 'duration' seconds then back to 'on' (0: for good); path: also along the flight of a projectile (an ice beam freezing a river); spread: the change then runs along the connected tiles of 'on' and of 'spreadOver', spreadDelay seconds a tile; radius: tiles around the hit; paintTerrain: instead, paints that terrain on the whole connected obstacle for 'duration' seconds; leaves: terrain painted where the obstacle was removed. decaysTo / decayTime: what an obstacle becomes by itself after that many seconds (a burning bridge burns out); planks, flatAlpha: provisional look.
